candidates.change_summary: Change the final returned value from true to false.
Return the success flag of the last low-level call instead of always true (introduces different return when calls succeed but returns vary).
Change the call target encoding to use delegatecall instead of call so the invoked contract's execution can modify this contract's state (including any storage named `transfer`).
Use call with value transfer of _value wei to the target call, potentially changing observable balances/state related to transfer.
Invert the success check to revert when the external call succeeds (i.e., revert on _s instead of on ! _s), changing post-call observable behavior.
Remove the require that _tos.length > 0 so the function can return true without making calls when _tos is empty, altering observable behavior for empty arrays.
